name: Zofia Lewandowska
bio:
Zofia's journey into motorsport was somewhat unexpected, stemming from a lifelong fascination with precision engineering and a brief stint as a mechanic's apprentice. After earning a degree in mechanical engineering, she initially worked in the automotive industry, but the allure of high-performance racing proved too strong. She transitioned into motorsport, quickly finding her niche in quality control, where her meticulous attention to detail and unwavering standards made her an invaluable asset.

At Iron Dames, Zofia is known for her systematic approach and ability to identify potential issues before they escalate. She views her role as not just checking boxes but safeguarding the team's performance and ensuring every component meets the highest standards of reliability. Her commitment to excellence and calm demeanor under pressure make her a respected and trusted member of the team. What sets Zofia apart is her ability to foster collaboration between engineers and mechanics, creating a seamless workflow that minimizes errors and maximizes efficiency.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly braided and pulled back into a bun
physical.description: Zofia has a focused gaze and a practical, no-nonsense air about her.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with checklists and diagrams.
Insists on using a specific type of pen for quality control reports.
Has a habit of tapping her fingers when deep in thought.
